commits.body:

Only the counting supplier's fixture value needs an explicit default. The product supports digest-pinned fixture data, public field provenance, and qualified dispatch from an accessible interface to the actual implementation.

The frozen transfer scored two complete cases out of five. Subsequent generators construct and reopen a parent/child search index, sample both Date aliases at each mutation, and subscribe to a real response stream. Targeted JVM runs exposed Lucene's fixed A/null, the fixed Date subclass's 1234/null/77, and Spring's outer WebClientResponseException caused by NumberFormatException on the historical parent. Its public interface was accessible although the private implementation name had failed direct lookup. The earlier attempts remain in the evidence.

All 56 selected suites passed. The numbered import recovered the six original histories and side-scoped predictions, and the fixture test detected both changed source bytes and a changed archived copy. Jobs 20261126-221949-repeat-every-development-observation-fro, 20261126-222003-qualify-all-five-retrospective-public-hi and 20261126-222004-generate-numbered-spring-and-vavr-caller repeat all final observations and controls on the independent runner.

commits.summary: Trace changed bodies across a public history (verification pending)
commits.body:
A changed method can run during another operation on the same retained object, or during subscription after a public method has returned. Generated replay now records the actual registered caller stack and original artifact for such hits, separately from synchronous entry-to-body chains. Additional changed selectors can qualify an already compiled and frozen public caller.

A direct replay recorded CharSequenceInputStream.reset on both original releases for both rewind histories. All 53 selected suites passed. Job 20261126-223636-trace-changed-bodies-during-public-strea repeats the stream check and traces the changed Lucene reads and reactive event decoder with the original caller bytes.

commits.summary: Compare stable JVM changed-method stacks (verification pending)
commits.body:
A JDK 25 hidden lambda in Lucene retained the same class host, method and descriptor but received a different VM address in each fresh process. Ignore just that address in the stack comparison, retain both raw receipts, and require the original public outcomes before accepting changed-body coverage. Check the public interface's provider after a successful method entry so a startup failure retains its separate evidence.

All 55 selected suites and the focused eight pre-entry tests passed. Both sides reproduced all seven parent and eight fixed Lucene changed-method hits, the Commons IO resets, and the actual Spring event builder below the subscription. Job 20261126-224614-verify-stable-changed-method-stacks-whil repeats the three traces independently and archives their raw frames.

commits.summary: Record generated caller qualification for all 31 questions
commits.body:
The original distributions yielded complete typed observations on all 45 registered histories on both sides. Twenty-six finite predictions held, three were refuted and two incorrect historical parent baselines stayed open. The immutable first transfer recovered two of five cases, below the three-case target. The scorecard retains its nine missing setups, the field origins and class digests, subsequent case-aware recipe engineering, unchanged controls and the separate cold-discovery denominator.

The numbered scaffold and build passed from a checkout with no authored caller. Cold, warm and empty-cache results agreed, and the warm comparison reused 44 of 62 question sides. A wrong expectation present before generation produced identical caller bytes and was refuted by the original fixed values. Verified all 16 collector receipts, 33 named outputs at their exact revisions, 38 case archives and 34 local links. The scorecard regenerates byte for byte. The final selection passed 55 suites. Collector 90692aac0ce2 contains the passing follow-up for the last changed-body check.
